[
مَصَبٌّ A place where water, or the like, pours out or forth, from a river into another river or into the sea &c., or from a tank or a gutter &c., and from high ground into a valley (see ضَاجِعَةٌ); and a sink, or sink-hole: pl. مَصَابُّ (occurring in the S and K in art. رفق, &c.).]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
